## About
Luxury Home Remodeling DFW is a residential remodeling company based in Colleyville. Our focus is kitchen, bathroom and home remodeling and design, along with outdoor kitchens, patios, fireplaces and flooring.
We partner with each homeowner to bring their remodel to life, and we put real care into the planning and design phase so the project stays comfortable to carry out and afford.
Payments are collected in proper stages as the work is completed, so you always know where your project stands.

## Services
- Bathroom Remodeling: Full bathroom updates, from layout and design through the finished room.
- Master Bathroom Remodeling: A considered redesign of the primary bath.
- Tub to Shower Conversion: Replacing an existing tub with a shower.
- Kitchen Remodeling: Kitchen renovations, including cabinet and countertop installation.
- Home Additions: Custom room additions planned around how your household lives.
- Outdoor Kitchen Remodeling: Cooking and gathering space built for the backyard.
- Outdoor Patio Construction: New patios for outdoor living.
- Flooring: Flooring installed as part of a remodel or on its own.

## FAQ
Q: How do payments work?
A: We ask for the cost of materials up front, then payments are made incrementally as each major stage of the remodel is completed.

Q: Do you offer free quotes?
A: Yes. Call us for a free quote on your project.

Q: Can you help with something unexpected, like a leak?
A: Yes. Beyond kitchens and bathrooms, we are ready to help with unexpected issues such as plumbing leaks.
